name: ready without validation
answer:
Idea: A guided workspace for founders to turn an uncertain product idea into an MVP specification.

Context and trigger: Teams often begin discussing features before they share a problem, user, or decision record.

Provisional user: First-time founders and small product teams.

Expected outcome: A clearer product definition and visible assumptions before building.

Hypotheses: Users will value a canonical staged method; guided prompts will be more useful than a blank document.

Open questions: Whether founders will complete all stages without facilitation; whether the method also helps non-software products.

Evidence: No user research has been collected yet.

name: assumptions presented as facts
answer: All founders build too much because they do not have a good method. This app will solve that problem for every founder by guiding them through fifteen stages.

name: missing idea framing
answer: An app with AI and dashboards.
